races.paceDynamic: Lady Litigator will dictate terms as the sole confirmed front runner, setting her own tempo without pressure from the break. Rebel Tribesman, Crackalackin and Calibos may press forward from prominent positions but none are committed pace forcers, allowing Lady Litigator comfortable sectionals. The strong hold-up contingent including Kamille Au Kanada, Shamsat, Fervent and Chartwell Jock will be tracking behind a moderate gallop. This sustainable pace scenario heavily favours hold-up horses who can unleash finishing kicks, as they won't be compromised by a searingly fast early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Litigator sets comfortable fractions and the prominent horses fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the hold-up horses with the strongest finishing kicks prevail. Kamille Au Kanada, Fervent and Shamsat all benefit from their preferred patient tactics in a truly-run race.

scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Tribesman and Crackalackin press Lady Litigator harder than expected through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and benefits those with proven stamina reserves who can sustain their effort. Rebel Tribesman's recent winning form and Crackalackin's consistency under pressure become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Litigator gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear at the last hurdle
scenarios.body: Her tactical advantage becomes insurmountable as the hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up. The prominent runners lack the acceleration to bridge the gap after tracking a steady pace throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is exceptionally slow and becomes a complete crawl
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure sprint finish where recent form and fitness trump tactical positioning. Those with sharp acceleration regardless of running style can capitalise on the tactical lottery that unfolds.

races.paceDynamic: Pleasure Garden is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start with his prominent style, likely setting a manageable gallop that won't blow the field apart. With five hold-up horses behind him including Chief Black Robe, Known Warrior, and Saint Polo, this creates a tactical race where the pace-setter could steal a march if allowed comfortable fractions. The lack of early pressure on Pleasure Garden means he can control the tempo and potentially kick clear before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenges. This race shape strongly favors horses that can race prominently or track the leader closely, as the hold-up horses may find themselves with too much ground to make up in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pleasure Garden Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Pleasure Garden gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The veteran front runner controls the pace unopposed and has enough left to repel late challenges, exploiting his tactical advantage over the massed hold-up horses. His prominent running style and class edge (RPR 111) prove decisive when allowed to dictate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly steady and multiple hold-up horses get organized runs
scenarios.body: Chief Black Robe and Known Warrior find gaps simultaneously and their superior ratings tell in a driving finish. The tactical disadvantage is overcome by pure class as the better horses assert late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Saint Polo Stalks and Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Saint Polo tracks closer than usual and gets first run on the field
scenarios.body: The highest-rated runner uses his class advantage to bridge the gap between pace-setter and hold-up horses, timing his challenge perfectly. His recent good form and fitness edge prove crucial in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Pleasure Garden ties up badly and multiple horses arrive together in a bunch finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery as tired legs and traffic problems decide the outcome rather than class or tactics. Wings On Wheels or Jiair Madrik could steal it at big odds in the confusion.
